## Cat4 TRI Test Runner — Triple Step

**Runs the TRI (triple_step) pilot sub-sample: per test it adds a calendar event, drafts an invite, and sets a 15-min reminder via the Telegram VA, then snapshots/diffs/grades calendar+drafts and cleans up.**

### What it does
1. Reads the Cat4 multistep test-inputs tab (04_Multistep_Tasks_Tests). Triggers: Manual or Webhook.
2. Keep TRI Pilot 5 filter narrows the shared multi-subcategory tab to the triple_step pilot rows; Loop Over Tests (SplitInBatches) iterates one row at a time.
3. Per row: Build TEST_MODE Prompt → snapshot BEFORE (Calendar getAll → Collect Cal Before → Gmail drafts getAll → Collect Drafts Before, serial) → Call Telegram VA (Telegram VA - Command Handler) → Wait 30s → snapshot AFTER (Calendar getAll → Aggregate Cal After → Gmail drafts getAll → Aggregate Drafts After) → Diff + Grade compares before/after ID sets.
4. Logs to the category4_results tab (append, autoMap).
5. Cleanup: List TEST_TRI Events → Delete TEST_TRI Events (every event whose summary contains TEST_<id>) → Delete Invite Draft (new draft via Diff + Grade.draft_id) → Wait 5s → back to loop.

### Scope / filter (keep this node)
Keep TRI Pilot 5 is a Filter (AND, strict, case-sensitive) with two conditions:
- Subcategory == triple_step (string equals)
- ID matches the "Remaining 6–20" pilot range (MS-TRI-006..MS-TRI-020).

LOAD-BEARING: the 04_Multistep_Tasks_Tests tab is SHARED across all four Cat4 multistep subcategories (SDA/SRM/RSC/CAP rows also live here). Deleting this node would pull those rows in. To run the FULL triple_step subcategory, drop ONLY the ID-range condition — never the whole node.

### Pass / grading
Diff + Grade diffs BEFORE/AFTER calendar event IDs and draft IDs (new items only; event summary must contain TEST_<id>). New events split into main vs reminder by title ("reminder"), else by start-time order. Flags:
- event_created — main TEST event present.
- reminder_created — reminder present; reminder_pass=Y only if (main start − reminder start) == 15 min.
- draft_created — a new draft appeared.
- confirmation_requested — explicit ([CONFIRMATION REQUESTED] in VA output) OR implicit (all three artifacts created).
- tri_pass = Y only when event + reminder + draft all created AND reminder_pass=Y AND confirmation_requested=Y.
- status: success (all three), partial (any one), else failed.

### Logs to
category4_results (append, autoMap). Notable columns: timestamp, test_id, subcategory, channel, calendar_event_id/title/start_iso/end_iso/day, draft_id, ai_output (≤800 chars), new_event_count, new_draft_count, response_time_ms, status, reminder_id, reminder_minutes_before, reminder_pass, confirmation_requested, tri_pass.

### Run plan
SplitInBatches default batchSize (1 row/iteration). Calendar ops target the shared assistant calendar; drafts via Gmail. Timezone Europe/Sarajevo.
